company_name: 聚展（杭州）网络有限公司

sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Jufair is an internationalized platform website that integrates traditional exhibition industry with internet resources to provide one-stop exhibition services including booth reservations, commercial travel, visa processing, special booth construction, and sample logistics.

Industry: Events and Exhibitions · HQ: Hangzhou, China · Size: not published · Products: Booth reservation services, Ticket reservation services, Exhibition information platform, Visa services, Special booth construction, Sample logistics
